data.action: 立于大型油画前侧身回眸，手持展览目录
data.animaCaption: Standing on the polished marble floor of a sunlit art gallery before gilded oil paintings, she holds a gallery catalog and turns toward the viewer with a refined smile.
data.camera: 全身镜头，建筑对称透视
data.description: 阳光透过玻璃天窗洒进莫塔里私人艺术画廊，珂莱塔身着象牙白粗花呢高腰套装，双手交叠在鎏金画框前驻足鉴赏。
data.lighting: 玻璃天窗柔和漫射光与画廊射灯
data.promptProse: Beneath the glass skylight of a private art gallery lined with gilded frames, Carlotta wears a tailored ivory tweed blazer and high-slit pencil skirt, holding an exhibition booklet with poised charm.
data.title: 珂莱塔 · 琉璃艺术画廊鉴赏油画名作
